== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] Starship, also identified by the name [[The Last Horizon]], is a legendary [[Aethertech]] vessel and a unique [[Zenith Device]]. Described as an original exemplar of starship engineering, the ship is approximately five hundred yards long and possesses a dark metal exterior that glows with blue-green or orange light. Its physical form is often compared to a predatory bird in a dive, featuring smooth plates and blade-like wings that can spark with electricity. While some legends suggest the ship is imbued with the enchantments of an astral [[dragon]], three [[World Spirits]], and various [[Archmagi]], its primary purpose is intended to be a transport for heroes and an exploratory vessel rather than a dedicated weapon. Despite its intended role, the starship possesses devastating combat capabilities. It features powerful [[Aethertech]] weaponry—including a prow gun composed of razor-edged energy—that can rival or exceed the strength of major planetary fleets and dreadnoughts. The vessel is capable of deploying advanced shields to deflect massive volleys, utilizing sensors, and even conjuring entire armies of supplementary ships or [[Nova-Bots]]. The ship operates under highly specific rules, maintaining a symbiotic relationship with a crew limited to exactly six members. The effectiveness of its core systems, such as its engines and [[power core]], is tied to the presence of this crew. Throughout history, the [[Zenith]] Starship has been viewed as a wild card with uncertain allegiances; while some fear it as a herald of [[destruction]], others recognize its role in heroic efforts to save the galaxy. It has been associated with the [[Rebel Queen]] and is capable of traveling through subspace warp.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The [[Zenith]] Starship is a vessel equipped with protections against magic and possesses unknown, potentially unpredictable capabilities. As an entity that requires individuals to prove themselves, it eventually accepts the protagonist as its Captain and houses the vessel's Captain's quarters. While the narrator's father seeks to benefit from the ship, the [[Galactic Union]] has specifically requested visual confirmation of its presence. Ultimately, the starship serves as the only entity capable of informing [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] that he possesses seven different versions of himself.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The [[Zenith]] Starship is a legendary vessel located in the [[Advocate]] hangar that possesses magic considered a forbidden secret of the galaxy. This starship, which can be personally matched by [[Starhammer]], features internal [[fabricators]] and a command structure that is open to challenge. After [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]] was teleported into the ship, she looked forward to taking full advantage of the vessel, which provides crew members with unrestricted access for at least five years. During its operations, the ship has been seen cresting a nearby asteroid and has undergone testing by a creature dragging claws across its hull. While the Captain successfully inherited the ship, its crew may eventually attempt to rescue [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|A bounty was once placed on the captured [[Zenith]] Starship, though the vessel eventually came into the possession of a crew. [[Benri Vallenar]]'s team utilized the ship, which served as the destination [[Ryzer Raithe|Ryzer]] and [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] needed to reach. During a confrontation, the vessel endured attacks from [[Visiri]] bullets and bolts. For the first time in centuries, the ship engaged in war at full power and provided the means for [[Horizon]] to share the burden of spellcasting.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith]] Starship is a [[Karoshan]] vessel associated with the [[Rebel Queen]] that resembles a dark-metal bird with blue-green shining surfaces. This exploratory transport for heroes serves as a home to certain wizards-in-training and has been used by students, [[Omega]], and the narrator. Though it possesses a prow gun made of razor-edged energy and the ability to conjure entire armies of ships, it has recently been seen missing its army of [[Nova-Bots]] and many supplementary vessels. After declaring war on the [[Galactic Union]], the ship became part of a [[Karoshan fleet]] invading [[Zykaros]]. During combat, the vessel was damaged by [[Aila Escalon|Aila]]'s [[Combat Art]] and demonstrated a capacity to attempt to take control from its own pilot.}}
